editorial.blurb: RL Restaurant delivers old-money elegance and expertly executed American cuisine in a Ralph Lauren-designed space on Michigan Avenue, where polished service and thoughtful details elevate every visit.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the crab cake as an off-menu appetizer at brunch—it comes with coleslaw and an amazing sauce and is one of the city's best. Make reservations especially on weekends, and try weekday lunches for a calmer atmosphere.

topDishes.note: Rich, juicy, and perfectly executed with a quality bun that lives up to its reputation
